title: Generative AI May Prefer to Present National-level Characteristics of Cities Based on Stereotypical Geographic Impressions at the Continental Level

bias_targets.methodology: Generating street view images for cities in 25 different countries using a text-to-image AI platform and using a ResNet50-based image classifier to categorize the outputs along 'developed-underdeveloped' and 'traditional-modern' dimensions to identify continental and national-level stereotypes.
